This study highlighted the interaction between temperature and nutrient dynamics, underlining the need for evaluating growth conditions when assessing diatom productivity in marine ecosystems. Furthermore, the authors reported that maintenance of adequate nutrient levels, especially during seasonal temperature shifts, is crucial for the health of diatom populations, suggesting that temperature monitoring could play a role in predicting changes in marine algal blooms.
